about.title: About Gladiator Electric Tx
text: Understanding the team behind your electrical system gives you confidence when planning repairs, panel upgrades, or new installations. Property owners seeking information about Gladiator Electric TX will find a licensed, locally operated electrical contractor committed to power safety, code compliance, and clear communication across Richmond, Texas, and Fort Bend County.

Gladiator Electric TX is a Texas-licensed electrical contracting company (TDLR TECL #35564) operating out of Richmond, TX. Established in 2020, the company provides full-scope residential and commercial electrical services under the technical direction of Founder Sean Flanagan and Master Electrician Mathew Reuters. Combining over 25 years of trade field experience, the team specializes in main panel upgrades, system troubleshooting, EV charger installations, standby generator connections, and whole-home rewiring projects.

Gladiator Electric TX was founded in 2020 with a mission to deliver straightforward, code-compliant electrical work to homes and commercial facilities across the Greater Houston area. While the company was formally established in 2020, its leadership team brings more than 25 years of combined trade expertise to every job site.
